text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- New school year starts today. President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali sends message to teachers focusing on the need to strengthen education in sciences and to take care of school buildings and equipment.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben spoke on the telephone on Sunday with French President Jacques Chirac. They discussed the visit President Ben Ali is to pay soon to France and international issues.
